name: typing-bubble
title: Typing Bubble
description: A speech or thought bubble (the kit SpeechBubble) that first shows three small ink squares rising one after another at 12 fps (waiting), then writes its text a few characters per frame with a stepped block caret. The whole text is laid out from the start (the rest is invisible), so the bubble never reflows. Text that grows over time (streamed answers) types on from where it stopped, never from zero. The typed text is aria-hidden; a visually hidden copy is announced once, complete, through aria-live="polite"; the dots are role="status" with aria-label="Typing". Reduced motion: still dots, the text at once. Gestures: G6 bubble, G7 waiting.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/typing-bubble". It draws its outline with SpeechBubble from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble" (installed with it). TypingDots, the three waiting squares, is exported too.

meta.tagline: A bubble that waits, then writes.
meta.usage:
import { TypingBubble } from "@/components/manga/typing-bubble"

<TypingBubble text={answer} typing={!answer} onDone={() => setReady(true)} />

props.name: text
props.description: The text to write. It may grow over time: only the new characters animate.

props.name: typing
props.description: Show the three waiting dots; the writing pauses meanwhile.

props.name: speed
props.description: Characters per frame at 12 fps. 0 shows the text at once.

props.name: tail / tailAlign
props.description: Where the tail points, as in SpeechBubble.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called each time the visible text catches up with text.

props.name: progress
props.description: Freezes the writing at this fraction (0–1), caret included: for previews and state grids.
